messages:
jamie: Quick sync — propose a very compact error payload + two header hints so SDKs and console can behave consistently.
morgan: What's broken today? Too many codes in dashboards, and customers asking "should we retry?"
jamie: Exactly. Dashboards show many categories, teams interpret 5xx/429 inconsistently. My proposal: don't invent new HTTP codes. Use standard codes + an action_hint and routing_hint (both in body & headers).
alex: +1. Avoid new status codes. SDK mapping table instead.
sara: Need deterministic machine readable semantics for "soft-degrade" vs "terminal" vs "retry-with-backoff".
chris: Suggest action_hint enum: "retry" | "degrade" | "fail". SDKs map to behavior. Also add human_message for console.
jamie: Example payload:
{
  "error": "model_unavailable",
  "message": "primary model in region overloaded, falling back",
  "action_hint": "degrade",
  "routing_hint": "fallback=small-llama-q4",
  "human_message": "Using lower-capacity model to keep latency low",
  "docs": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#model-unavailable"
}
morgan: Rename client_hint -> action_hint to avoid ambiguity.
jamie: Headers: X-Redwood-Action: degrade and X-Redwood-Routing: fallback=small-llama-q4 — useful for infra, traces, and console badges.
sara: Telemetry should include error_category (quota | capacity | model | network) so dashboards can group reliably.
chris: Optional severity numeric (1..5) for badge priority, keep optional.
alex: SDK guidance: map action_hint -> behavior. e.g., retry => exponential backoff; degrade => surface a non-blocking notice and don't retry; fail => surf support link.
jamie: Quota example (HTTP + headers + body):
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Redwood-Action: retry
X-Rate-Limit-Reset: 1765003600
Content-Type: application/json

{ "error": "quota_exceeded", "message": "project quota exhausted", "action_hint": "retry", "error_category": "quota", "human_message": "Quota exhausted — consider reserved capacity" }
sara: Security note: quota_hint/remaining_tokens only returned to owners/admins (RBAC). Don't leak across tenants.
morgan: Rollout UX: separate model_regress category for quality regressions vs infra capacity.
chris: Console badge copy: short pill "Degraded (fallback)" + expand for human_message and docs link.
alex: Ops: ensure traces/logs carry action_hint + routing_hint so incident pages surface cause chain.
jamie: Action items:
- agree on names: action_hint, routing_hint, error_category, human_message, docs
- header names: X-Redwood-Action, X-Redwood-Routing
- add telemetry tags: error_category & optional severity
- SDKs: publish mapping table + default behaviors
- security: RBAC for quota hints
sara: I'll draft an RFC in /eng-platform/rfcs and collect objections by EOD Tue; if no blocks, we'll land it into console/SDK sprint.
chris: I'll prototype console badge text & SDK examples.
alex: Add gradeboard tests asserting SDK reaction for each action_hint.
morgan: :thumbsup: incremental and clear.
deploy-bot: RFC file created: /eng-platform/rfcs/0008-error-action-hints.md at 1765000360
jamie: Thanks — I'll seed the RFC with payloads and examples and link telemetry dashboards.
